## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 371 captures during July 2021. Capture activity was maintained throughout the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. No additional operational issues were identified in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. There were 5 ungradable image sets, representing an ungradable rate of 1.3. These images could not be used for a grading outcome and should continue to be monitored through routine quality review. The result provides a measure of the proportion of captures requiring attention because the images were not adequate for assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 91 referable results during July 2021. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the central point of the grading turnaround distribution was 1 day for the reporting period. The referable results and grading lag should be considered alongside the capture volume and image-quality findings when reviewing site operations. Overall, the report records activity, image quality and grading outcomes for North City Eye Clinic for July 2021.
